sections.body: Sudoku is a number puzzle. In a small 4 by 4 Sudoku, you put the numbers 1, 2, 3 and 4 into the squares.

There are three rules. Each ROW has every number once. Each COLUMN has every number once. Each BOX (a block of 4 squares, 2 by 2) has every number once. A number can never be there twice in the same row, column or box.
To fill an empty square, ask: which number is missing? If a row has 1, 3 and 4, the empty square must be 2.
Draw a 4 by 4 grid. Put 1, 2, 3 and 4 in the top row in any order. Then fill the next row so no number is above itself in the same column.
Start with the 4 by 4 grid in the Games area of the app. Let your child say the rule out loud before each move: 'Which number is missing from this row?'. There is no timer and no score.

quiz.q: A 4 by 4 Sudoku row has 1, 3 and 4. One square is empty. Which number goes there?
hints: Each row needs the numbers 1, 2, 3 and 4 once.
Which of 1, 2, 3, 4 is not in the row yet?
Example: a row with 2, 3 and 4 is missing 1, so 1 goes in the empty square. Do the same with 1, 3 and 4.
quiz.explain: The row has 1, 3 and 4, so 2 is the one that is missing.

quiz.q: A 2 by 2 box has the numbers 2, 4 and 1. Which number goes in the last square?
hints: A box also has each number once.
The box needs 1, 2, 3 and 4. Which one is not there yet?
Example: a box with 1, 2 and 3 is missing 4. Find the missing number for 2, 4 and 1.
quiz.explain: The box needs 1, 2, 3 and 4 once each. 2, 4 and 1 are there, so 3 is missing.

hints: A finished row has 1, 2, 3 and 4, each once.
Look for a row that repeats a number. That row is wrong.
Example: 1 3 4 2 is a finished row because each of 1, 2, 3 and 4 appears once. Check each row here the same way.
quiz.explain: 2 4 1 3 has each number once. 1 2 2 3 has two 2s and no 4. 3 3 1 4 has two 3s and no 2.
